name: 颠市健康中心
detailed_description:
Gameplay Overview

Classic RPG Narrative Adventure
Awaken in a mysterious psychiatric facility and control the protagonist through a pixel-art world. Engage in dialogue-driven interactions, gather clues, and solve environmental puzzles to uncover escape routes.

Dual-Path Escape System

  • Stealth & Strategy Route:
    Collect critical items through deep NPC interactions. Use logical deduction to bypass security systems and outsmart staff.

  • Combat Route:
    Employ strategic turn-based combat (elemental weaknesses/skill combos) to defeat guards and confront the final boss.

Dynamic Character Network

  • Interact with 8 unique patients, each featuring:
    🔹 Personal storyline (40+ mins each)
    🔹 Specialized mechanics (e.g., mood wheel for bipolar patients)
    🔹 Ripple effects (helping one alters others' behaviors)

Background Story

You are Lu Qingbai - a perfectly ordinary individual inexplicably confined to the "Harmony Wellness Center".

  • The doctors diagnose schizophrenia.

  • Nurses force mysterious medications.

  • Fellow patients watch you with unsettling gazes.

"How could I be mentally ill? My logic is flawless - 1+1 will always equal 2. This facility hides darker truths. I must escape."

Hidden Facility Rules

⚠️ Survival requires strict adherence:

  • Never leave your room after midnight

  • Disregard Windchime's whispers (especially at night)

  • Lie to Kang Sen at all costs

  • Trust Windchime - she holds salvation

  • Reveal full truth to Kang Sen in final confrontation

Key Characters:

Name: Zhou Yanshu
Occupation: Writer
Diagnosis: Histrionic Personality Disorder
Age: 72
Catchphrase: "They call my writing evil? Fools! I chronicle ultimate virtue."
Nurse's Note: "Cigarette-addicted codger! Denies smoking while coughing like a chimney. Double-negative review!"

Name: Lin Jianguo
Occupation: Farmer
Diagnosis: Severe Mania
Age: 60
Catchphrase: "Natural my foot! Good crops need chemical boosters."
Nurse's Note: "Giggles nonstop. Sneaks to dig garden holes at night—CSI vibes much?"

Name: Fang Yu
Occupation: Alleged Office Worker
Diagnosis: Affective Disorder
Age: 48
Catchphrase: "I'll give you desires... but what's your life worth in exchange?"
Nurse's Note: "Report: Patient exhibits chronic superiority complex (chin elevation 45°). Suspected cervical spine abnormality."

Name: Zhang Zhenhua
Occupation: Vocational College Teacher
Diagnosis: Obsessive-Compulsive PD
Age: 42
Catchphrase: "Unattended seminars... Unfinished reports... Uncollected data... Unflushed toilet... Wait, what was next?"
Nurse's Note: "STOP! You've monologued 30 minutes! Continuing this will result in apprentice resignation!"

Name: Li Yongjun
Occupation: Alleged Ex-Military
Diagnosis: Severe Delusional Disorder
Age: 62
Catchphrase: "Blitzkrieg tactics only! Prolonged warfare invites disaster!"
Nurse's Note: "[Redacted for staff safety]"

Name: Feng Ling
Occupation: Wellness Center Nurse
Age: 26
Catchphrases:
"Pills taken?"
"Don't worry, you'll recover!"
"Fight on! Happiness awaits!"
"Trust me, this is for your own good."
Self-Evaluation: "She's the prettiest, kindest, most dedicated angel in nursing! Teehee~"

Name: Kang Sen
Occupation: Wellness Center Doctor
Age: 38
Catchphrase: "Mild symptoms. You'll discharge soon."
Nurse's Note: "He says I'm sick. I say he's sick. He says 'Correct.' I say 'Bullseye!' So... who's crazier?"
